description: JavaScript code for handling quick create modal dialogs in SuiteCRM's email module, including AJAX calls and UI updates.

methods.name: openQuickCreateModal
methods.description: Opens a modal dialog for quick creation of email-related records, loads content via AJAX, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: submitQuickCreateForm
methods.description: Submits the quick create form via AJAX, displays success or error messages, and redirects on success.

methods.name: showErrorMessage
methods.description: Displays an error message box in the UI.
